# defectdojo_notification_webhook (List Resource)

Lists the DefectDojo notification webhooks, ordered by ID. The generated configuration has no `header_value_wo`, which DefectDojo returns in plain text: add it, with a `header_value_wo_version`, to manage it.

Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. Terraform returns at most 100 results unless the `list` block sets `limit`. `terraform query -generate-config-out` writes every attribute that has a value, including those the provider otherwise leaves to others when they are not configured (such as `authorized_users` and `tags`): remove the ones another system manages before applying the generated configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the notification webhooks and generate import blocks and
# configuration with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
list "defectdojo_notification_webhook" "all" {
  provider = defectdojo
}

# Only those whose name contains "chat", ignoring case
list "defectdojo_notification_webhook" "filtered" {
  provider = defectdojo

  config {
    name_contains = "chat"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Only list the notification webhooks whose name contains this text, ignoring case.
